'''Osten Dal'Nay''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as one of the co-leaders of the [[Cularin Militia]], after defecting from the [[Thaereian military]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
